title: USCIS 2025 Civics Question Entry
description: One question in the knowledge base. Source of truth = USCIS M-1778 (09/25). One file per question under data/questions/<section>/qNNN.json; compiled into a single knowledge-base.json at build time.

is_starred.description: true = part of the 65/20 asterisk subset

lead_in.description: Conversational handoff shown before multiple acceptable answers. Include whenever there is more than one official answer.

disambiguation.description: Plain-language prose untangling synonyms/overlaps or distinguishing look-alike terms. Include whenever such confusion is possible.

key_elements.description: LEAN: only concepts truly essential to be counted correct. Never stricter than a real officer.

dynamic.description: Populated only when answer_type = dynamic_lookup. Never hard-code a person's name in static data.

text.description: CRISP KID VOICE: short sentences, plain words, ~2-3 sentences. Land the 'so what' but cut every word a kid would skip. Hard cap enforces concision.

fun_fact.description: REQUIRED on every question. Must be SURPRISING and memorable (drama, irony, zany detail, 'wait really?') AND land its own 'so what' — why the surprise matters. One voice for all ages. Not a textbook restatement. Tier-1 sourced.

text.description: CRISP KID VOICE, ~2-3 short sentences. Surprising + lands its so-what. Cut every name/detail that doesn't add to a child's wonder. Hard cap enforces concision.

source_url.description: Tier-1 whitelist only. Validated by CI against the domain allowlist.

source_verified.description: Set true only after a human confirms the deep link resolves and supports the claim.

mnemonic.description: Optional memory device. May be whimsical/coincidental. ALWAYS labeled as a memory device in the UI, never as a fact.

source_url.description: Source for the hook itself (broader than the fact whitelist is OK).

micro_story.description: Optional 2-3 sentence narrative, mainly for people/events.

concept_ids.description: Links to concepts.json for the recurring big ideas.

media.description: OPTIONAL. Audio paths are derived by convention: audio/{id3}_{field}.mp3 for questions (e.g. audio/q005_why.mp3) and audio/term_{term_id}_{part}.mp3 for shared vocabulary. The manifest is generated by scripts/gen-recording-assets.js. Use this block only to OVERRIDE a derived path or attach an image.

audio_overrides.description: field name -> explicit audio path; overrides the convention for that fragment only.
